grader.scenario: Trade-in credit of Â£150 missing from mobile invoice 30 days post warehouse receipt
grader.notes: Exemplary billing resolution featuring two handled customer outbursts (including a late acknowledgment 3 turns after initial complaint), manual ledger allocation, direct debit locking, and instant PDF reissue.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care and billing' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Gabriel warmly throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent delivered late empathy at [02:40] after warehouse lookup ('I completely understand how frustrating and alarming it is to see a seventy-five pound invoice without your agreed one hundred and fifty pound trade-in credit...'), and handled second anxiety outburst at [07:15].

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the trade-in credit omission and billing issue accurately at [01:25].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed mobile number accurately without repeating questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent manually bound trade-in voucher, zeroed invoice, locked Bacs sweep, and emailed updated PDF.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, reassuring, and professional tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding statement details and direct debit dates.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed receipt of updated zero-balance statement PDF and verified direct debit sweep halted.
